subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native clients preserve every PNG attachment, preserve only PNGs whose alpha would be lost, or continue normalizing all processed images to JPEG?
rationale: Current shipped Apple behavior intentionally normalizes PNG to JPEG, while this PR establishes a broader lossless format policy with different size and fidelity tradeoffs; source inspection cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Preserve Alpha PNGs
options.body: Keep PNG only when transparency would be lost, retain bounded JPEG for opaque inputs, and prove Android picker, Apple chat, and iOS share delivery.

options.title: Preserve Every PNG
options.body: Adopt the PR's all-PNG policy intentionally after real-client proof confirms acceptable dimensions, payloads, and gateway compatibility.

options.title: Retain JPEG Normalization
options.body: Keep the current transport policy and close or narrow this PR if consistent bounded delivery outweighs PNG format preservation.

recommendation.title: Preserve Alpha PNGs
recommendation.body: Keep PNG only when transparency would be lost, retain bounded JPEG for opaque inputs, and prove Android picker, Apple chat, and iOS share delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-platform product-policy choice, and the repository identifies @steipete as the project decision owner.
